title: Investigate a rescan republishing a compacted test run and losing its retained registration
outcome: Determine with a deterministic interleaving whether a rescan started before compaction installation can republish the run or overwrite retained registration metadata, and preserve installed evidence across any confirmed race using existing owners.
acceptance: A deterministic rescan/compaction interleaving proves or refutes the reported stale-index publication and registration-loss trace, distinguishing source hypothesis from reproduced behavior.

If confirmed, retained original registration remains discoverable after compaction/rescan and a newer failed run cannot disappear from early selection; otherwise record the exact guard that rules out the trace. Any repair has focused regression and required review/gate evidence.
